The VK3 population was highly resistant to both permethrin and DDT with only 12 and 6% mortality after 1 h exposure, respectively... WHO adult bioassays were undertaken in 2- to 5-day-old, non-blood-fed female mosquitoes, using filter paper impregnated with 4% DDT, 0.75% permethrin, 0.1% bendiocarb and 4% dieldrin following WHO protocol (WHO, 1998) and mortality rate recorded after a 24 -h recovery period.

Moderate resistance was observed against the carbamate bendiocarb, with 91% mortality (Supplementary Table S4)...
